title: eval-harness: add CI hook to run prompt-set regression and push eval metrics to metrics pipeline
author: Maya Chen
description: Add a lightweight CI hook that runs the eval-harness prompt-set regression suite on PRs touching prompts or evaluation code and pushes aggregate eval metrics to our metrics pipeline. Motivation: prevent prompt regressions from being merged (we had two incidents in Q4 where prompt changes regressed key metrics) and increase visibility of small model-quality shifts. This change implements: 1) a new GH Action 'eval-prompt-regression' that triggers on push/PR when files in eval-harness/prompt_sets/ or eval-harness/core/ are modified, 2) an adapter that runs the eval suite subset (fast mode) and emits a JSON summary, 3) a CI step that pushes metrics to the internal eval-metrics ingestion endpoint (with auth via CI creds) and marks the check as failed if defined thresholds (accuracy_delta, hallucination_rate) are exceeded, 4) a config file eval-harness/ci/quality_gates.yml to allow per-prompt-set thresholds and allowlist for noisy tests, and 5) docs and an example on how to add new prompt-sets and gate rules. The description below includes test notes and rollout plan. Test notes: unit tests for the adapter and mocked push were added; the GH Action was exercised in forked runs and a staging pipeline; thresholds set conservatively and will be tightened after 2 weeks of telemetry. Rollout: feature is enabled by default for eval-harness-owned PRs; teams can opt out by adding [skip-eval-regression] to PR body. Follow-ups: (a) add a dashboard alert for metric drift (ENG-4189), (b) wire the check to auto-assign a product reviewer on failures. Related: ENG-4122, SUP-1284.
